UPDATE notification_delivery_outbox_intent
            SET published_at = now(),
                claim_token = NULL,
                claim_expires_at = NULL,
                updated_at = now()
            WHERE notification_id = $1
              AND position = $2
              AND claim_token = $3
              AND claim_expires_at > now()
              AND published_at IS NULL
            RETURNING notification_id
